description:
Rank Czech term deposits (termínované vklady) for a deposit and a term (délka v měsících) by the rate (úrok, sazba), with the net yield for the whole term after the 15 % tax.

Offers only for new clients (noví klienti) count only with client='new'; promotions (akce) can be excluded; need_early_withdrawal keeps banks where an early withdrawal (předčasný výběr) is possible without the bank's consent. Banks whose limits do not take the amount are listed in outside_limits.

Examples:
  - "Nejlepší termínovaný vklad na rok pro 200 000" -> amount=200000, term_months=12
  - "Vklad na 3 měsíce, jsem nový klient" -> term_months=3, client='new'

amount.description: Deposit in CZK (vklad v Kč), whole number 1 000–10 000 000

client.description: 'new' also counts offers only for a bank's new clients (noví klienti)

limit.description: How many offers to return, best first

need_early_withdrawal.description: Only banks where an early withdrawal (předčasný výběr) is possible without asking the bank

name: hlidac_compare_term_deposits

asOf.description: When the rates were last updated (ISO 8601)

net_yield_term.description: CZK for the whole term after 15 % tax, simple interest, no renewal

rate.description: % p. a. for this deposit and term

standard_rate.description: The bank's standard rate next to a promotion

tax_withheld.description: false: the bank does not withhold the tax, the client declares it

title: Compare Czech term deposits
